title: Remove redundant null-forgiving operators across all files (~67 instances)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
~67 instances of `!` null-forgiving operators where nullable reference type warnings are disabled, making them redundant and misleading.

**By area:**
- **Razor Pages (20 instances):** `Admin.razor` (L2020, L2240), `Chat.razor` (L777, L803, L805, L820, L821, L827, L832, L1648), `Models.razor` (L307), `TagManager.razor.cs` (L11, L14), `Tasks.razor` (L1460), `SensitiveValue.razor` (L26, L27)
- **Controllers (3 instances):** `AdminController.cs` (L56), `McpController.cs` (L134), `PagesController.cs` (L78, L97)
- **Services (~44 instances):** `AdminSettingsService.cs` (L71, L524), `CodeSearchService.cs` (12 instances across L273-L2959), `ChatServices.cs` (7 instances across L676-L2248), `ChatToolCatalog.cs` (6 instances), `SecurityServices.cs` (4 instances across L707-L1138), `MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` (5 instances across L640-L1952), `PageService.cs` (3 instances), `SemanticEmbeddingSearchService.cs` (6 instances), `MemoryGovernanceServices.cs` (1), `LoggingObservabilityService.cs` (3), `TaskDomainService.cs` (2), `WindowsServiceCommands.cs` (2), `McpAgentToolHandler.cs` (5), `Hosting/MemorySmithSecuritySetup.cs` (1), `Benchmarks/CodeSearchBenchmarks.cs` (1), `SearchBenchmarks.cs` (1)

## Impact
Null-forgiving operators convey no safety guarantee when nullable warnings are disabled, misleading code readers and adding noise. This is a mechanical, high-ROI cleanup.

## Action Required
Remove all `!` operators in these files where nullable reference type warnings are disabled (`#nullable disable` or project-level setting). Change to proper null checks or guard clauses where null safety is actually needed.

## Effort
~22h (bulk of the effort is the sheer number of instances)

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
